report.clinical_summary: The patient presents with fatigue, throbbing bilateral headaches, difficulty concentrating, mild neck stiffness, and sleep disturbance over 2-3 weeks. They express moderate concern about the cause but not overwhelming distress. Their illness beliefs appear to be centered on symptoms rather than a named condition, with limited understanding of the underlying cause and minimal discussion of personal or treatment control. Given the biomedical communication style, the patient has not raised psychosocial themes or explored emotional meaning beyond expressing general worry. The patient has not discussed beliefs about medications or treatment, as none have been prescribed.
